map.骨折线清晰锐利、断端无骨痂、周围软组织肿胀、可能伴新鲜血肿影像: Fracture line clear and sharp, no callus at the ends, surrounding soft tissue swelling, possibly with imaging of a fresh haematoma
map.骨折线模糊或消失、有骨痂形成、断端骨质疏松或硬化、软组织肿胀消退: Fracture line blurred or disappeared, callus formed, osteopenia or sclerosis at the ends, soft tissue swelling resolved
map.：儿童愈合快（2-4周骨痂明显），老年人愈合慢: : children heal fast (obvious callus at 2 to 4 weeks), the elderly heal slowly
map.：肋骨骨折2-3周可见骨痂；长骨干需4-8周；颅骨骨折愈合极慢: : rib fractures show callus at 2 to 3 weeks, long bone shafts need 4 to 8 weeks, skull fractures heal extremely slowly
map.：粉碎性骨折比简单骨折愈合慢: : comminuted fractures heal more slowly than simple fractures
map.：良好固定促进愈合，反复移位延缓愈合: : good fixation promotes healing, repeated displacement delays it
map.：营养不良、糖尿病、骨质疏松等影响愈合: : malnutrition, diabetes and osteoporosis affect healing
map.：骨皮质弯曲但未完全断裂，儿童特有: : the cortex bends without complete breakage, unique to children
map.：骨折线经骺板，需注意对生长发育的影响: : the fracture line passes through the growth plate, requiring attention to its effect on growth and development
map.：骨膜完整，骨皮质裂纹，X线可能漏诊: : the periosteum is intact with a cortical crack, which X-ray can miss
map.⚠️ 儿童不同愈合期骨折共存可能提示虐待（多次损伤）: ⚠️ Fractures at different healing stages coexisting in a child may suggest abuse (repeated injury)
map.⚠️ 本工具基于一般规律估算，个体差异大，结果仅供教学参考，不能替代专业法医/放: ⚠️ This tool estimates from general patterns with large individual variation; results are for teaching reference only and cannot replace a professional forensic or radiological assessment.

map.按影像学特征分级：新鲜骨折（<2 周）骨折线清晰锐利、无/少骨痂、软组织肿胀明显: Grade by imaging features: recent fracture (under 2 weeks) has a clear sharp fracture line, no or little callus and marked soft tissue swelling; old fracture (over 3 weeks) has a blurred fracture line, callus formation, resolved swelling and closure of the medullary cavity.
map.X 线示股骨干骨折线清晰、无骨痂、周围软组织肿胀明显 → 新鲜骨折（<2 周）；: X-ray shows a clear femoral shaft fracture line, no callus and marked surrounding soft tissue swelling, indicating a recent fracture (under 2 weeks); another case shows a blurred fracture line, massive callus and resolved swelling, indicating an old fracture (over 3 weeks). Coexistence suggests two separate force applications weeks apart.
map.大致：伤后 1~2 周开始骨痂、4~8 周明显；但受年龄、血供、固定影响，仅给区: Roughly: callus starts at 1 to 2 weeks after injury and becomes obvious at 4 to 8 weeks. It is affected by age, blood supply and fixation, so only a range can be given, not precision to the day; clinical correlation is needed.
map.无骨痂就一定是新鲜吗？: Does no callus definitely mean recent?
map.多数情况成立，但营养差、制动不佳、病理性骨折可延迟骨痂；应排除这些因素并结合软组: Usually yes, but poor nutrition, poor immobilisation and pathological fractures can delay callus. Exclude these factors and combine with soft tissue and bone marrow signals (MRI).
map.根据骨折影像学特征（骨折线清晰度、骨痂形成、断端密度等）判断骨折愈合阶段，推断骨: Judge the healing stage of a fracture from imaging features (fracture line sharpness, callus formation, end density and so on) to infer when it occurred, helping distinguish recent from old fractures.
